source.text: שִׁגָּי֗וֹן לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֥ר לַיהוָ֑ה עַל־דִּבְרֵי־כ֝֗וּשׁ בֶּן־יְמִינִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: A shiggaion of David, which he sang to YHWH concerning [the] words of Cush, a Benjaminite.

en.L: A shiggaion of David, which he sang to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} concerning [the] words of Cush, a Benjaminite.
en.B: A shiggaion of David, which he sang to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} about Cush, a man of the tribe of Benjamin.
en.R: A song of David. He sang it to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} because of what Cush, from the tribe of Benjamin, said.

fr.L: Un shiggayon de David, qu’il chanta {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} au sujet des paroles de Koush, un Benjaminite.
fr.B: Un shiggayon de David, qu’il chanta {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} au sujet de Koush, un homme de la tribu de Benjamin.
fr.R: Un chant de David. Il l’a chanté {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} à cause de ce qu’avait dit Koush, de la tribu de Benjamin.

sw.L: Shigayoni ya Daudi, aliyomwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuhusu maneno ya Kushi, Mbenyamini.
sw.B: Shigayoni ya Daudi, aliyomwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuhusu Kushi, mtu wa kabila la Benyamini.
sw.R: Wimbo wa Daudi. Alimwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sababu ya maneno aliyosema Kushi, wa kabila la Benyamini.

es.L: Sigayón de David, que cantó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} acerca de [las] palabras de Cus, benjamita.
es.B: Sigayón de David, que él cantó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} acerca de Cus, un hombre de la tribu de Benjamín.
es.R: Canto de David. Se lo cantó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} por lo que había dicho Cus, de la tribu de Benjamín.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 3, the title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: shiggaion: a kind of song whose sense is unknown
alternatives: a song of wandering or excitement
decisions.reason: The word (shiggayon) is used only here and, in the plural, in Habakkuk 3:1. It names a kind of song; some link it with a verb for wandering or reeling, others with a word for lament. Literal and Balanced keep it.

decisions.choice: the words of Cush, a Benjaminite: an enemy not otherwise known
decisions.reason: No Cush of Benjamin appears elsewhere in Scripture. Saul was a Benjaminite, and so was Shimei, who cursed David (2 Samuel 16:5-8), so Cush was probably one of Saul's supporters who slandered David. "The words of Cush" may mean what he said, or simply "the matter of Cush".

decisions.choice: A song
decisions.reason: Readable says only that it is a song, since the exact sense is unknown (m1).

decisions.choice: "shiggayon" kept as a name (Literal, Balanced), "Un chant" at Readable; "Koush" for the man's name
decisions.reason: The kind of song the word names is unknown (m2), so French keeps it as the English does, in the spelling of the terms note. The name Cush is written "Koush" so that French readers say it as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: "Shigayoni" kept as a name at Literal and Balanced; "Wimbo" (a song) at Readable
decisions.reason: What kind of song a shiggaion was is not known (m2). Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew word in a Swahili form, as the English keeps it; Readable says only that it is a song.

decisions.choice: Sigayón
decisions.reason: The Hebrew shiggaion names a kind of song whose exact sense is no longer known. Literal and Balanced keep the word in its Spanish form, "sigayón"; Readable says "Canto", as the English Readable says "A song".

source.text: יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּךָ֣ חָסִ֑יתִי הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי מִכָּל־רֹ֝דְפַ֗י וְהַצִּילֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH my God, in you I have taken refuge; save me from all my pursuers and deliver me,

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I have taken refuge; save me from all my pursuers and deliver me,
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, I have made {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} my refuge. Save me from all who are hunting me down, and rescue me,
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, I have come to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for safety. Save me from all the people who are chasing me. Rescue me!

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} je me suis réfugié ; sauve-moi de tous mes poursuivants et délivre-moi,
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, j’ai fait de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} mon refuge. Sauve-moi de tous ceux qui me traquent, et délivre-moi,
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, je suis venu me mettre à l’abri auprès de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Sauve-moi de tous ceux qui me poursuivent. Délivre-moi !

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} nimekimbilia; uniokoe kutoka kwa wote wanaonifuatia na kunitoa,
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, nimekufanya {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} kuwa kimbilio langu. Uniokoe kutoka kwa wote wanaoniwinda, na kunitoa mikononi mwao,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, nimekuja {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} ili nipate usalama. Uniokoe kutoka kwa watu wote wanaonifukuza. Unitoe mikononi mwao!

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me he refugiado; sálvame de todos mis perseguidores y líbrame,
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, he hecho de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mi refugio. Sálvame de todos los que me persiguen para darme caza, y rescátame,
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, he venido a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} para estar a salvo. Sálvame de toda la gente que me persigue. ¡Rescátame!

decisions.choice: I have taken refuge: I have run to you for shelter
decisions.reason: The verb (chasah) is the one of 2:12 and 5:12. The psalmist has already fled to the LORD; now he asks for rescue.

decisions.choice: deliver me, / or he will tear: one sentence across two verses
decisions.reason: The request runs on into verse 3 ("or he will tear me"), so this verse ends with a comma.

decisions.choice: who are hunting me down (B); who are chasing me (R)
decisions.reason: The verb (radaf) is to chase or hunt; Balanced and Readable turn the noun into a clause.

source.text: פֶּן־יִטְרֹ֣ף כְּאַרְיֵ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י פֹּ֝רֵ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃

records.literal_gloss: lest he tear like a lion my soul, ripping, and there is no one delivering.

en.L: lest he tear my soul like a lion, ripping [it], and there is no one to deliver.
en.B: or he will tear me apart like a lion, dragging me off with no one to rescue me.
en.R: If {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do not, my enemy will attack me like a lion. He will tear me to pieces, and no one will save me.

fr.L: de peur qu’il ne déchire mon âme comme un lion, en [la] mettant en pièces, sans personne pour délivrer.
fr.B: sinon il me déchirera comme un lion et m’emportera, sans personne pour me sauver.
fr.R: Si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne le fais pas, mon ennemi m’attaquera comme un lion. Il me mettra en pièces, et personne ne me sauvera.

sw.L: asije akairarua nafsi yangu kama simba, akiipasua, wala hakuna wa kuokoa.
sw.B: la sivyo atanirarua kama simba, akinikokota bila mtu wa kuniokoa.
sw.R: Usipofanya hivyo, adui yangu atanishambulia kama simba. Atanirarua vipande vipande, wala hakuna atakayeniokoa.

es.L: no sea que como un león despedace mi alma, arrastrándola, y no haya quien [la] libre.
es.B: o me despedazará como un león y me arrastrará sin que nadie me rescate.
es.R: Si {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no lo haces, mi enemigo me atacará como un león. Me hará pedazos, y nadie me salvará.

decisions.choice: he: the enemy, one of the pursuers
decisions.reason: The verb is singular: the chief enemy, perhaps Cush of the title, is pictured as a lion.

decisions.choice: like a lion, ripping: a lion carrying off its prey
decisions.reason: Lions still lived in the land (1 Samuel 17:34-35). The picture is of prey dragged away where no shepherd can save it.

decisions.choice: my soul: me, my life
decisions.reason: The soul (nefesh) is the whole living person.

decisions.choice: If you do not, my enemy
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence and names the enemy (m1).

source.text: יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי אִם־עָשִׂ֣יתִי זֹ֑את אִֽם־יֶשׁ־עָ֥וֶל בְּכַפָּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH my God, if I have done this, if there is wrong in my palms,

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, if I have done this, if there is injustice in my palms,
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, if I have done what they say, if my hands are guilty of wrong,
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, maybe I have done what they say. Maybe I have done something wrong.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, si j’ai fait cela, s’il y a de l’injustice dans mes paumes,
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, si j’ai fait ce qu’ils disent, si mes mains sont coupables d’injustice,
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, j’ai peut-être fait ce qu’ils disent. J’ai peut-être fait quelque chose de mal.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, kama nimefanya hili, kama kuna uovu viganjani mwangu,
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, kama nimefanya wanayosema, kama mikono yangu ina hatia ya kosa,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, huenda nimefanya wanayosema. Huenda nimetenda jambo baya.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, si he hecho esto, si hay injusticia en mis palmas,
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, si he hecho lo que dicen, si mis manos son culpables de algún mal,
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, tal vez he hecho lo que dicen. Tal vez he hecho algo malo.

decisions.choice: if I have done this: an oath of innocence
decisions.reason: Verses 4-6 are an oath: "if I have done this ..., then let the enemy ...". The psalmist calls a curse on himself if he is guilty, to declare that he is not (compare Job 31:5-40). "This" is the charge Cush has made.

decisions.choice: in my palms: on my hands, in what I have done
decisions.reason: The hands stand for what a person does; wrong "in the palms" is guilt for what they have done (Isaiah 59:6).

decisions.choice: what they say
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "this" refers to (m1).

source.text: אִם־גָּ֭מַלְתִּי שֽׁוֹלְמִ֥י רָ֑ע וָאֲחַלְּצָ֖ה צוֹרְרִ֣י רֵיקָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: if I have repaid my friend [with] evil, or plundered my foe without cause,

en.L: if I have repaid the one at peace with me [with] evil, or have plundered my foe without cause,
en.B: if I have paid back a friend with harm, or robbed my enemy for no reason,
en.R: Maybe I have hurt a friend or robbed an enemy for no reason.

fr.L: si j’ai rendu le mal à celui qui était en paix avec moi, ou si j’ai dépouillé mon adversaire sans raison,
fr.B: si j’ai payé un ami de retour par du mal, ou si j’ai volé mon ennemi sans motif,
fr.R: J’ai peut-être fait du mal à un ami ou volé un ennemi sans raison.

sw.L: kama nimemlipa mabaya yule aliye na amani nami, au nimemnyang'anya mtesi wangu bila sababu,
sw.B: kama nimemlipa rafiki kwa madhara, au nimemnyang'anya adui yangu bila sababu,
sw.R: Huenda nimemwumiza rafiki au nimemnyang'anya adui bila sababu.

es.L: si he pagado con mal al que estaba en paz conmigo, o he despojado a mi adversario sin motivo,
es.B: si he devuelto daño a un amigo, o he robado a mi enemigo sin razón,
es.R: Tal vez le he hecho daño a un amigo o le he robado a un enemigo sin razón.

decisions.choice: the one at peace with me: a friend, an ally
decisions.reason: The word (sholem) is someone who is at peace with him, a friend or ally (Psalm 41:10).

decisions.choice: plundered: stripped, robbed
decisions.reason: The verb (chalats) usually means to rescue, as in 6:5, but it can also mean to strip or plunder, which fits the list of wrongs here. Some read it in its usual sense, as a parenthesis: "I who rescued my enemy without cause", recalling how David spared Saul (1 Samuel 24; 26).

source.text: יִֽרַדֹּ֥ף אוֹיֵ֨ב׀נַפְשִׁ֡י וְיַשֵּׂ֗ג וְיִרְמֹ֣ס לָאָ֣רֶץ חַיָּ֑י וּכְבוֹדִ֓י׀לֶעָפָ֖ר יַשְׁכֵּ֣ן סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: let an enemy pursue my soul and overtake [it], and trample to the earth my life, and my glory in the dust let him lay. Selah.

en.L: let an enemy pursue my soul and overtake [it]; let him trample my life to the ground and lay my glory in the dust. Selah
en.B: then let my enemy chase me down and catch me; let him trample my life into the ground and leave my honor lying in the dust. Selah
en.R: If I have, then let my enemy chase me and catch me. Let him crush me into the ground and bring me to shame. Selah

fr.L: que l’ennemi poursuive mon âme et [l’]atteigne ; qu’il piétine ma vie jusqu’à terre et couche ma gloire dans la poussière. Sélah
fr.B: alors que mon ennemi me pourchasse et me rattrape ; qu’il écrase ma vie contre le sol et laisse mon honneur traîner dans la poussière. Sélah
fr.R: Si c’est le cas, que mon ennemi me poursuive et m’attrape. Qu’il m’écrase contre le sol et me couvre de honte. Sélah

sw.L: basi adui na aifuatie nafsi yangu na kuipata; na ayakanyage maisha yangu chini ardhini, na autie utukufu wangu mavumbini. Sela
sw.B: basi adui yangu anifukuze na kunikamata; ayakanyage maisha yangu ardhini na kuiacha heshima yangu ikiwa mavumbini. Sela
sw.R: Kama nimefanya hivyo, basi adui yangu anifukuze na kunikamata. Aniponde chini na kuniaibisha. Sela

es.L: que persiga el enemigo mi alma y [la] alcance; que pisotee en tierra mi vida y ponga mi gloria en el polvo. Selah
es.B: entonces, que mi enemigo me persiga y me atrape; que aplaste mi vida contra el suelo y deje mi honra tirada en el polvo. Selah
es.R: Si es así, que mi enemigo me persiga y me atrape. Que me aplaste contra el suelo y me cubra de vergüenza. Selah

decisions.choice: let an enemy pursue: the curse of the oath
decisions.reason: This is the "then" of the oath begun in verse 4: if he is guilty, let the enemy do to him what he has been praying to escape.

decisions.choice: my glory: my honor, or my very self
decisions.reason: Glory (kavod) is honor, as in 3:4 and 4:3; here, beside "soul" and "life", it may also stand for the self (compare Genesis 49:6).

decisions.choice: bring me to shame
alternatives: lay my glory in the dust
decisions.reason: Readable says what laying one's honor in the dust means (m2).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

source.text: ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה׀בְּאַפֶּ֗ךָ הִ֭נָּשֵׂא בְּעַבְר֣וֹת צוֹרְרָ֑י וְע֥וּרָה אֵ֝לַ֗י מִשְׁפָּ֥ט צִוִּֽיתָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Arise, YHWH, in your anger; lift yourself up against the furies of my foes, and awake for me; judgment you have commanded.

en.L: Arise, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger; lift {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} up against the fury of my foes, and awake for me; [the] judgment {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have commanded.
en.B: Rise up, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger! Stand up against the rage of my enemies. Wake up and act for me; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have ordered justice to be done.
en.R: Get up, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! Be angry and stand up against my furious enemies. Wake up and help me! You have said that what is right must be done.

fr.L: Lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère ; dresse-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} contre la fureur de mes adversaires, et éveille-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour moi ; [le] jugement, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as ordonné.
fr.B: Debout, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère ! Dresse-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} contre la rage de mes ennemis. Réveille-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et agis pour moi ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as ordonné que justice soit faite.
fr.R: Lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Mets-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} en colère et dresse-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} contre mes ennemis furieux. Réveille-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et viens m’aider ! Tu as dit que ce qui est juste doit être fait.

sw.L: Inuka, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; ujiinue dhidi ya ghadhabu ya watesi wangu, na uamke kwa ajili yangu; hukumu umeiamuru.
sw.B: Simama, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}! Jiinue dhidi ya ghadhabu ya adui zangu. Amka unitendee; umeamuru haki itendeke.
sw.R: Amka, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Kasirika, usimame dhidi ya adui zangu wenye hasira kali. Usikae kimya tena; unisaidie! Umesema kwamba haki lazima itendeke.

es.L: Levántate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira; álzate contra la furia de mis adversarios, y despierta por mí; [el] juicio {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has ordenado.
es.B: ¡Álzate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira! Ponte en pie contra la rabia de mis enemigos. Despierta y actúa a mi favor; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has ordenado que se haga justicia.
es.R: ¡Levántate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! Enójate y enfréntate a mis enemigos furiosos. ¡Despierta y ayúdame! Tú has dicho que debe hacerse lo que es justo.

decisions.choice: Arise, LORD: the battle cry of the ark
decisions.reason: As in 3:8, the words recall Numbers 10:35.

decisions.choice: awake: act at last
decisions.reason: God does not sleep (Psalm 121:4), but when he seems not to act, the psalmists call on him to wake up (Psalm 44:24).

decisions.choice: judgment you have commanded: you have already decreed justice
decisions.reason: The verb is in the past form: the LORD has already decreed that justice be done, and the psalmist asks him to carry it out. Some read it as a request.

decisions.choice: Rise up (B); Get up (R)
decisions.reason: As in 3:8.

source.text: וַעֲדַ֣ת לְ֭אֻמִּים תְּסוֹבְבֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ לַמָּר֥וֹם שֽׁוּבָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And an assembly of peoples let surround you, and over it to the height return.

en.L: And let the assembly of peoples surround {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and over it return to the height.
en.B: Let the peoples gather around {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and take {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} seat again above them on high.
en.R: Let the people of all nations gather around {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Then go back to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} throne in heaven above them and judge.

fr.L: Et que l’assemblée des peuples {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}entoure, et au-dessus d’elle retourne sur la hauteur.
fr.B: Que les peuples se rassemblent autour de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, et reprends {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} place au-dessus d’eux, là-haut.
fr.R: Que les gens de toutes les nations se rassemblent autour de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Puis retourne sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} trône dans le ciel, au-dessus d’eux, et juge.

sw.L: Na kusanyiko la watu likuzunguke, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} juu yake urudi mahali pa juu.
sw.B: Watu wa mataifa wakusanyike kukuzunguka, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} uketi tena kitini {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}} juu yao huko juu.
sw.R: Watu wa mataifa yote wakusanyike kukuzunguka. Kisha urudi kwenye kiti {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} cha enzi mbinguni juu yao, uhukumu.

es.L: Y que la asamblea de los pueblos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rodee, y sobre ella vuelve a lo alto.
es.B: Que los pueblos se reúnan a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} alrededor, y vuelve a ocupar {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} asiento por encima de ellos, en lo alto.
es.R: Que la gente de todas las naciones se reúna a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} alrededor. Luego regresa a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} trono en el cielo, por encima de ellos, y juzga.

decisions.choice: the assembly of peoples: a court gathered for judgment
decisions.reason: The peoples gather around God as in a law court, with God as judge (verse 9).

decisions.choice: return to the height: take your judgment seat
decisions.reason: "The height" is heaven, where God's throne is (Psalm 93:4). He is asked to take his seat again as judge. Some change one letter to read "sit" instead of "return"; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: and judge
decisions.reason: Readable says why God takes his seat, which verse 9 makes plain.

source.text: יְהוָה֮ יָדִ֪ין עַ֫מִּ֥ים שָׁפְטֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כְּצִדְקִ֖י וּכְתֻמִּ֣י עָלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH judges peoples; judge me, YHWH, according to my righteousness and according to my integrity on me.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} judges peoples; judge me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, according to my righteousness and according to my integrity [that is] in me.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} judges the peoples. Give me justice, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, because I am in the right and have done no wrong.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} judges all people. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, judge me and show that I am right, because I have not done anything wrong.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} juge [les] peuples ; juge-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, selon ma justice et selon mon intégrité [qui est] en moi.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} juge les peuples. Rends-moi justice, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car je suis dans mon droit et je n’ai rien fait de mal.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} juge tous les peuples. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, juge-moi et montre que j’ai raison, parce que je n’ai rien fait de mal.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawahukumu watu; unihukumu, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa kadiri ya haki yangu na kwa kadiri ya unyofu wangu [ulio] ndani yangu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawahukumu watu wa mataifa. Unipe haki, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu niko sahihi na sijatenda kosa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawahukumu watu wote. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unihukumu na uonyeshe kwamba niko sahihi, kwa sababu sijafanya jambo lolote baya.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juzga a [los] pueblos; júzgame, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, conforme a mi justicia y conforme a mi integridad [que hay] en mí.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juzga a los pueblos. Hazme justicia, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque tengo la razón y no he hecho ningún mal.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juzga a toda la gente. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, júzgame y muestra que tengo la razón, porque no he hecho nada malo.

decisions.choice: judge me: decide my case, vindicate me
decisions.reason: To judge (shafat) someone here is to give a ruling in his favor (Psalm 26:1).

decisions.choice: my righteousness, my integrity: innocent of the charge
decisions.reason: The psalmist does not claim to be sinless. He claims to be in the right in this matter, innocent of what he is accused of (verses 4-5).

decisions.choice: because I am in the right and have done no wrong (B)
alternatives: according to my righteousness and my integrity
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what righteousness and integrity mean here (m2).

source.text: יִגְמָר־נָ֬א רַ֨ע׀רְשָׁעִים֮ וּתְכוֹנֵ֪ן צַ֫דִּ֥יק וּבֹחֵ֣ן לִ֭בּ֗וֹת וּכְלָי֗וֹת אֱלֹהִ֥ים צַדִּֽיק׃

records.literal_gloss: Let come to an end, please, [the] evil of wicked [people], and establish [the] righteous, and testing hearts and kidneys [is] righteous God.

en.L: Please let the evil of the wicked come to an end, and establish the righteous, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} who test hearts and kidneys, righteous God.
en.B: Bring the evil of the wicked to an end, and make the righteous secure, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the righteous God who tests minds and hearts.
en.R: Put an end to the evil that wicked people do. Keep good people safe. You are a God who does what is right, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know what people think and want.

fr.L: Que prenne fin, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, le mal des méchants, et affermis le juste, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui sondes les cœurs et les reins, Dieu juste.
fr.B: Mets fin au mal que font les méchants, et donne au juste un appui solide, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es le Dieu juste qui sonde les pensées et les cœurs.
fr.R: Arrête le mal que font les méchants. Garde en sécurité ceux qui font le bien. Tu es un Dieu qui fait ce qui est juste, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sais ce que les gens pensent et désirent.

sw.L: Tafadhali uovu wa waovu ukome, na umthibitishe mwenye haki, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unayepima mioyo na figo, Ee Mungu mwenye haki.
sw.B: Ukomeshe uovu wa waovu, na uwaimarishe wenye haki, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe Mungu mwenye haki unayepima mawazo na mioyo.
sw.R: Ukomeshe maovu wanayoyatenda watu waovu. Uwalinde watu wema. Wewe ni Mungu anayetenda haki, na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unajua watu wanachofikiri na wanachotaka.

es.L: Que se acabe, por favor, la maldad de los malvados, y afirma [al] justo, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} que pruebas corazones y riñones, Dios justo.
es.B: Pon fin a la maldad de los malvados y da seguridad a los justos, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres el Dios justo que examina mentes y corazones.
es.R: Acaba con el mal que hacen los malvados. Protege a las personas buenas. Tú eres un Dios que hace lo que es justo, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} sabes lo que la gente piensa y desea.

decisions.choice: hearts and kidneys: thoughts and feelings
decisions.reason: In Hebrew thought the heart is the seat of thought and will, and the kidneys of the deepest feelings (Jeremiah 11:20; 17:10). God examines the whole inner person.

decisions.choice: testing ... righteous God: said to God
decisions.reason: The words are addressed to God and describe him, giving the reason he can be trusted to judge.

decisions.choice: minds and hearts (B); what people think and want (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the parts that mean these things in English (m1); Literal keeps the Hebrew picture.

decisions.choice: las personas buenas
decisions.reason: As in Proverbs, where the English Readable says "good people" for the righteous, Readable Spanish says "las personas buenas"; Literal and Balanced keep "el justo, los justos".

records.literal_gloss: My shield [is] on God, saving [the] upright of heart.

en.L: My shield [is] upon God, who saves the upright of heart.
en.B: My shield is God, who rescues those whose hearts are right.
en.R: God protects me like a shield. He saves people who are honest and good.

fr.L: Mon bouclier [est] sur Dieu, qui sauve les cœurs droits.
fr.B: Mon bouclier, c’est Dieu, qui délivre ceux qui ont le cœur droit.
fr.R: Dieu me protège comme un bouclier. Il sauve les gens honnêtes et bons.

sw.L: Ngao yangu [iko] juu ya Mungu, aokoaye wanyofu wa moyo.
sw.B: Ngao yangu ni Mungu, anayewaokoa wale wenye mioyo minyofu.
sw.R: Mungu ananilinda kama ngao. Yeye huwaokoa watu walio waaminifu na wema.

es.L: Mi escudo [está] sobre Dios, que salva a los rectos de corazón.
es.B: Mi escudo es Dios, que rescata a los de corazón recto.
es.R: Dios me protege como un escudo. Él salva a la gente honrada y buena.

decisions.choice: my shield is upon God: God holds my shield
decisions.reason: The phrase says that his protection rests on God, as a shield is held by its bearer. Compare 3:4, "you are a shield around me".

decisions.choice: upright of heart: people whose hearts are straight
decisions.reason: The upright (yashar) are straight, not crooked; "of heart" means inwardly so, not only in appearance.

source.text: אֱ֭לֹהִים שׁוֹפֵ֣ט צַדִּ֑יק וְ֝אֵ֗ל זֹעֵ֥ם בְּכָל־יֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: God [is] a righteous judge, and God [is] indignant every day.

en.L: God [is] a righteous judge, and a God who is indignant every day.
en.B: God is a righteous judge, a God who is angry at evil every day.
en.R: God is a fair judge. Every day {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is angry at the evil people do.

fr.L: Dieu [est] un juge juste, et un Dieu qui s’indigne chaque jour.
fr.B: Dieu est un juge juste, un Dieu qui s’indigne contre le mal chaque jour.
fr.R: Dieu est un juge honnête. Chaque jour, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est en colère contre le mal que font les gens.

sw.L: Mungu [ni] mwamuzi mwenye haki, na Mungu mwenye ghadhabu kila siku.
sw.B: Mungu ni mwamuzi mwenye haki, Mungu anayekasirikia uovu kila siku.
sw.R: Mungu ni mwamuzi wa haki. Kila siku anakasirikia maovu wanayotenda watu.

es.L: Dios [es] juez justo, y un Dios que se indigna cada día.
es.B: Dios es un juez justo, un Dios que se enoja contra el mal cada día.
es.R: Dios es un juez imparcial. Cada día {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se enoja por el mal que hace la gente.

decisions.choice: indignant: angry at wrong
decisions.reason: The verb (za'am) is to be indignant. The text does not say with whom; the context shows it is with the wicked who do not turn (verse 13).

decisions.choice: at evil (B); at the evil people do (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what God is angry at (m1).

source.text: אִם־לֹ֣א יָ֭שׁוּב חַרְבּ֣וֹ יִלְט֑וֹשׁ קַשְׁתּ֥וֹ דָ֝רַ֗ךְ וַֽיְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: If he does not turn, his sword he will sharpen; his bow he has bent and made it ready.

en.L: If [one] does not turn back, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will sharpen {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sword; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has bent {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} bow and made it ready.
en.B: If anyone will not turn back, God will sharpen {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sword; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has strung {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} bow and taken aim.
en.R: If people do not turn from evil, God will sharpen {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sword. He has {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} bow ready to shoot.

fr.L: Si [l’on] ne revient pas, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aiguisera {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} épée ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tendu {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} arc et l’a tenu prêt.
fr.B: Si quelqu’un refuse de revenir, Dieu aiguisera {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} épée ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a bandé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} arc et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vise.
fr.R: Si les gens ne se détournent pas du mal, Dieu aiguisera {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} épée. Son arc est prêt à tirer.

sw.L: Mtu asipogeuka, atanoa upanga {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; ameupinda upinde {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na kuuweka tayari.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote asipogeuka, Mungu atanoa upanga {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; amefunga uzi wa upinde {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na kulenga.
sw.R: Watu wasipoacha maovu, Mungu atanoa upanga {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Upinde {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} uko tayari kupiga.

es.L: Si [uno] no se vuelve, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} afilará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} espada; {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} arco ha tensado y [lo] ha preparado.
es.B: Si alguien no se vuelve atrás, Dios afilará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} espada; ha tensado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} arco y apunta.
es.R: Si la gente no se aparta del mal, Dios afilará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} espada. Tiene {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} arco listo para disparar.

decisions.choice: If he does not turn, he will sharpen: God readies his weapons against the unrepentant
alternatives: if he (the wicked) does not turn, he sharpens his sword (against the righteous)
decisions.reason: The subject changes without notice. Most likely: if the wicked man does not turn back, God will sharpen his sword. Some read the wicked man as the subject throughout, arming himself, and his weapons turning against him (verses 15-17).

decisions.choice: turn: turn back from evil, repent
decisions.reason: To turn (shuv) is to change direction, here from wrongdoing (Ezekiel 18:30).

decisions.choice: bent his bow: strung it, ready to shoot
decisions.reason: A bow was bent by stepping on it to string it (literally "trodden").

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God as the one who sharpens the sword (m1).

source.text: וְ֭לוֹ הֵכִ֣ין כְּלֵי־מָ֑וֶת חִ֝צָּ֗יו לְֽדֹלְקִ֥ים יִפְעָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And for him he has prepared weapons of death; his arrows he makes into burning [ones].

en.L: And for him {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has prepared weapons of death; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arrows flaming.
en.B: He has made ready deadly weapons for that person, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} turns {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arrows into fire.
en.R: He has deadly weapons ready for that person. His arrows are on fire.

fr.L: Et pour lui {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a préparé des armes de mort ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rend {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} flèches brûlantes.
fr.B: Il a préparé des armes mortelles pour cet homme-là, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} change {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} flèches en feu.
fr.R: Il a des armes mortelles toutes prêtes pour lui. Ses flèches sont en feu.

sw.L: Na kwa ajili yake ameandaa silaha za mauti; mishale {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} anaifanya ya moto.
sw.B: Ameandaa silaha za kuua kwa ajili ya mtu huyo, na anaigeuza mishale {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kuwa moto.
sw.R: Ana silaha za kuua tayari kwa ajili ya mtu huyo. Mishale {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} inawaka moto.

es.L: Y ha preparado para él armas de muerte; hace llameantes {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} flechas.
es.B: Ha preparado armas mortales para esa persona, y convierte {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} flechas en fuego.
es.R: Tiene armas mortales listas para esa persona. Sus flechas están encendidas.

decisions.choice: for him: for the one who will not turn
decisions.reason: "Him" is the person of verse 13 who will not turn back.

decisions.choice: burning arrows: fire-arrows
decisions.reason: Arrows wrapped with burning material were shot in sieges. God's judgment is pictured as a warrior's attack (Deuteronomy 32:23, 42).

source.text: הִנֵּ֥ה יְחַבֶּל־אָ֑וֶן וְהָרָ֥ה עָ֝מָ֗ל וְיָ֣לַד שָֽׁקֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, he travails [with] iniquity, and he conceives trouble and gives birth to falsehood.

en.L: Look, he is in labor with iniquity; he has conceived trouble and given birth to falsehood.
en.B: See how the wicked person is pregnant with evil: having conceived trouble, he gives birth to lies.
en.R: Look at the wicked person. He plans evil the way a woman carries a baby. He plans trouble, and what comes out is lies.

fr.L: Voici, il est en travail d’iniquité ; il a conçu la peine et enfanté le mensonge.
fr.B: Voyez le méchant : il est gros de malfaisance ; il a conçu le malheur et il enfante le mensonge.
fr.R: Regardez le méchant. Il prépare le mal comme une femme porte un bébé. Il prépare des ennuis, et ce qui en sort, ce sont des mensonges.

sw.L: Tazama, ana utungu wa uovu; amechukua mimba ya taabu na kuzaa uongo.
sw.B: Tazama jinsi mtu mwovu alivyo na mimba ya uovu: akiisha kuchukua mimba ya taabu, anazaa uongo.
sw.R: Mwangalie mtu mwovu. Anapanga maovu kama mwanamke anavyobeba mimba. Anapanga taabu, na kinachozaliwa ni uongo.

es.L: Mira, está con dolores de parto de iniquidad; ha concebido malicia y ha dado a luz mentira.
es.B: Así es el malvado: está preñado de maldad; concibió malicia, y da a luz mentiras.
es.R: Así es la persona malvada. Planea el mal como una mujer lleva a un bebé en su vientre. Planea problemas, y lo que sale son mentiras.

decisions.choice: travail, conceive, give birth: evil planned and carried out
decisions.reason: The picture of pregnancy and birth shows evil growing from a plan to a deed (Job 15:35; Isaiah 59:4; James 1:15). What is born is "falsehood": it will deceive the one who planned it.

decisions.choice: he: the wicked person
decisions.reason: From here the subject is the wicked person, no longer God.

decisions.choice: the wicked person
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the subject (m2).

source.text: בּ֣וֹר כָּ֭רָֽה וַֽיַּחְפְּרֵ֑הוּ וַ֝יִּפֹּ֗ל בְּשַׁ֣חַת יִפְעָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: A pit he has dug, and he has hollowed it out, and he has fallen into the hole [that] he made.

en.L: A pit he has dug, and he has hollowed it out, and he has fallen into the hole he made.
en.B: He dug a pit and scooped it out deep, and fell into the very hole he made.
en.R: He dug a deep hole to trap others, but he fell into it himself.

fr.L: Une fosse, il [l’]a creusée, et il l’a approfondie, et il est tombé dans le trou qu’il a fait.
fr.B: Il a creusé une fosse et l’a rendue profonde, et il est tombé dans le trou même qu’il avait fait.
fr.R: Il a creusé un trou profond pour piéger les autres, mais c’est lui qui y est tombé.

sw.L: Shimo amechimba, naye amelichimba kwa kina, naye ameanguka katika tundu alilolifanya.
sw.B: Alichimba shimo na kulifukua kwa kina, akaanguka katika shimo lile lile alilolifanya.
sw.R: Alichimba shimo refu ili kuwanasa wengine, lakini yeye mwenyewe akaanguka ndani yake.

es.L: Un hoyo ha cavado, y lo ha ahondado, y ha caído en la fosa que hizo.
es.B: Cavó una fosa y la ahondó, y cayó en el mismo hoyo que había hecho.
es.R: Cavó un hoyo profundo para atrapar a otros, pero él mismo cayó en él.

decisions.choice: a pit: a trap dug for animals or people
decisions.reason: Hunters dug pits covered over to catch animals. The one who sets a trap for others is caught by it (Proverbs 26:27; Psalm 9:16).

decisions.choice: to trap others
decisions.reason: Readable says what the pit was for (m1).

source.text: יָשׁ֣וּב עֲמָל֣וֹ בְרֹאשׁ֑וֹ וְעַ֥ל קָ֝דְקֳד֗וֹ חֲמָס֥וֹ יֵרֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: His trouble returns on his head, and on his crown his violence comes down.

en.L: His trouble returns on his [own] head, and on his [own] crown his violence comes down.
en.B: The trouble he caused comes back on his own head; his violence falls on his own skull.
en.R: The trouble he made for others comes back on him. His own violence hurts him.

fr.L: Sa peine retombe sur sa [propre] tête, et sur son [propre] crâne descend sa violence.
fr.B: Le malheur qu’il a causé retombe sur sa propre tête ; sa violence s’abat sur son propre crâne.
fr.R: Les ennuis qu’il préparait pour les autres retombent sur lui. Sa propre violence le blesse.

sw.L: Taabu yake inarudi juu ya kichwa chake [mwenyewe], na juu ya utosi wake ukatili wake unashuka.
sw.B: Taabu aliyoisababisha inamrudia kichwani pake mwenyewe; ukatili wake unaanguka juu ya utosi wake mwenyewe.
sw.R: Taabu aliyowasababishia wengine inamrudia yeye mwenyewe. Ukatili wake mwenyewe unamwumiza.

es.L: Su malicia se vuelve sobre su [propia] cabeza, y sobre su [propia] coronilla desciende su violencia.
es.B: El mal que causó vuelve sobre su propia cabeza; su violencia cae sobre su propio cráneo.
es.R: Los problemas que causó a otros se vuelven contra él. Su propia violencia le hace daño.

decisions.choice: on his head, on his crown: on himself
decisions.reason: Evil that returns on a person's head falls on that person (1 Kings 2:32). The crown is the top of the head.

decisions.choice: returns: comes back
decisions.reason: It is the verb (shuv) of verse 13: the one who would not turn back finds his evil turning back on him.

source.text: אוֹדֶ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה כְּצִדְק֑וֹ וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה שֵֽׁם־יְהוָ֥ה עֶלְיֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: I will give thanks to YHWH according to his righteousness, and I will sing praise [to the] name of YHWH Most High.

en.L: I will give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} according to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} righteousness, and I will sing praise to the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} Most High.
en.B: I will thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does what is right, and I will sing praises to the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} Most High.
en.R: I will thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} always does what is right. I will sing praise to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God who is above all.

fr.L: Je rendrai grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} selon {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} justice, et je chanterai le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} Très-Haut.
fr.B: Je remercierai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait ce qui est juste, et je chanterai le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} Très-Haut.
fr.R: Je remercierai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait toujours ce qui est juste. Je chanterai pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu qui est au-dessus de tout.

sw.L: Nitamshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa kadiri ya haki {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, nami nitaliimbia sifa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Aliye Juu Kabisa.
sw.B: Nitamshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sababu anatenda yaliyo haki, nami nitaliimbia sifa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Aliye Juu Kabisa.
sw.R: Nitamshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu daima anatenda yaliyo haki. Nitamwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sifa, Mungu aliye juu ya wote.

es.L: Daré gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} conforme a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} justicia, y cantaré alabanzas al nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} Altísimo.
es.B: Daré gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace lo que es justo, y cantaré alabanzas al nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} Altísimo.
es.R: Daré gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} siempre hace lo que es justo. Cantaré alabanzas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios que está por encima de todo.

decisions.choice: Most High: God above all
decisions.reason: Most High ('elyon) is a title of God as ruler over all the earth (Genesis 14:18-20; Psalm 47:3).

decisions.choice: according to his righteousness: for his justice
decisions.reason: The psalm ends with thanks for the righteousness it appealed to (verses 9-12): God has judged rightly.

decisions.choice: the God who is above all
decisions.reason: Readable explains the title (m1).

decisions.choice: "Aliye Juu Kabisa" (the One who is highest of all) for Elyon (L, B); "Mungu aliye juu ya wote" at Readable
decisions.reason: As in the Pentateuch ("Mungu Aliye Juu Kabisa"), the title is a relative phrase written with capitals. Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Altísimo
decisions.reason: The Hebrew Elyon, "Most High", is a title for God above all. Spanish says "Altísimo", as for this title elsewhere; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.
